近百式神齐齐冲杀，黑压压一片扑面而来。

枯骨式神骨骼咯吱作响，利爪泛着冷光；鬼面式神面具狰狞，口中溢出腥臭黑气；兽首式神身形魁梧，獠牙外露，带着蛮荒凶性。

四象锁煞阵催动之下，式神彼此气息相连，煞气叠加，形成一体战阵，远比零散放养的式神强悍数倍，冲杀之间，阴风卷着黑雾，遮天蔽日，压得人呼吸发紧。

“雷法开道！”

范梦雪身形掠至阵型最前，素白道袍鼓荡，双手结神霄雷法根本印诀。

天际云层隐有雷鸣滚动，丝丝银白雷光从虚空凝聚，萦绕她周身，照亮阴沉的古观庭院。

“神霄御雷，千霆灭煞！”

咔嚓——

无数细密雷弧凭空迸发，化作漫天雷网，向前铺展笼罩整片山门区域。

至阳雷光落下，最先撞上冲在最前的一排式神。

滋啦——

黑烟滚滚升腾，式神被雷光缠体，黑雾瞬间被灼烧消融，枯骨崩裂、鬼面碎裂，成片式神在雷网之中僵直、虚化、溃散。

神霄雷法本就克制阴魂式神，如今大范围铺开，更是群杀利器，硬生生挡住了式神第一波冲锋。

可四象锁煞阵底蕴深厚，阵纹源源不断供给阴气，溃散的式神黑雾很快又在阵力牵引下重新凝聚，虽战力稍减，依旧悍不畏死，持续往前扑杀。

“阵纹不除，式神杀不尽。”胡九郎目光扫过古观四角，“东南西北四隅暗藏阵眼，由地底阴脉接引煞气，我去破四象阵基，你们守住山门，拖住式神军团，不要让它们冲破阵型。”

话音落下，他身形一闪，脚踏八卦步法，身形飘忽如影，避开正面式神浪潮，沿着院墙阴影，朝着古观四角阵眼掠去。

渡边苍玄冷眼旁观，看出胡九郎意图，冷哼一声，抬手捏诀，想要调动阵纹阻拦。

“你的对手是我。”范梦雪眸光冷冽，雷木法尺一指，一道凝练雷柱破空而出，直逼石坛上的渡边苍玄。

雷光霸道凌厉，带着轰鸣之势，逼得渡边苍玄不得不放弃阻拦，抬手祭出黑雾结界抵挡。

Nearly a hundred shikigami charged in unison, and a black mass rushed towards them.

The bones of the withered-bone shikigami are creaking, and the sharp claws are glowing coldly; the ghost-faced shikigami has a ferocious mask, and smelly black gas leaks from its mouth; the beast-headed shikigami is burly, with exposed fangs, and carries a wild and ferocious character.

Under the activation of the Four Elephants Locking Evil Formation, the Shikigami are connected with each other, and the evil energies are superimposed to form a unified battle formation, which is many times more powerful than the scattered Shikigami. During the charge, the dark wind rolls up the black mist, covering the sky and the sun, making people's breathing tight.

"Lefa clears the way!"

Fan Mengxue's figure swept to the front of the formation, her plain white Taoist robes fluttering, and her hands formed the fundamental seal of Shenxiao's Thunder Technique.

There was hidden thunder rolling in the clouds in the sky, and strands of silver-white thunder light condensed from the void, lingering around her and illuminating the gloomy ancient courtyard.

"The divine sky controls thunder, and a thousand thunders destroy evil spirits!"

Click——

Countless fine lightning arcs burst out of thin air, turning into thunder nets all over the sky, spreading forward to cover the entire mountain gate area.

When the Zhiyang lightning fell, it was the first to hit the row of shikigami rushing forward.

Zila——

Black smoke rose billowingly, and the shikigami were entangled in the lightning. The black mist was burned and melted in an instant, withered bones cracking, ghost faces shattering, and pieces of shikigami stiffened, blurred, and collapsed in the thunder net.

Shenxiao's thunder method was originally used to restrain the Yinhun Shikigami, but now it was spread out over a large area and became a powerful weapon for group killing, blocking the first wave of Shikigami's charge.

However, the Four Symbols Locking Evil Formation has a profound foundation, and the formation patterns continuously supply Yin Qi. The dissipated Shikigami Black Mist quickly regrouped under the pull of the formation. Although the combat power was slightly reduced, it was still fearless and continued to attack forward.

"If the formation patterns are not removed, the shikigami cannot be killed." Hu Jiulang glanced at the four corners of the ancient temple, "There are formation eyes hidden in the four corners of the southeast, northwest, and the evil energy is drawn from the underground Yin veins. I will break the four elephants formation base. You guard the mountain gate and hold back the shikigami legions to prevent them from breaking through the formation."

As he finished speaking, he flashed forward, using Bagua footwork. His figure was as erratic as a shadow, avoiding the frontal wave of shikigami, and followed the shadow of the courtyard wall towards the four corners of the ancient temple.

Watanabe Cangxuan watched with cold eyes, seeing Hu Jiulang's intention, he snorted coldly, raised his hand to make a secret, and wanted to mobilize the formation pattern to block it.

"Your opponent is me." Fan Mengxue's eyes were cold, and with a finger of the Thunder Wood Ruler, a condensed thunder pillar shot out of the air, heading towards Watanabe Cangxuan on the stone altar.

The lightning was overbearing and fierce, with a roaring force, forcing Watanabe Cangxuan to give up the obstruction and raise his hand to use the black mist barrier to resist.
